The likely root cause is **productcatalogservice socket exhaustion or a socket leak**, beginning around 08:03 UTC. Its open sockets jump from 5 to roughly 47–49 and remain elevated, alongside increases in memory and CPU. At the same time, its request rate falls and p90 latency rises. Frontend latency and socket count then rise, while checkoutservice and recommendationservice latency also increase—consistent with impact propagating from a dependency they call. The telemetry does not include usable error-log counts, so it does not establish whether requests are failing as well as slowing down.
